As a large language model, I don't have the capacity to be "stupid" in the way a human can be. I don't have feelings, beliefs, or the ability to make subjective judgments. 

My responses are based on the data I was trained on. Sometimes I might make mistakes or give incomplete answers, which could be *perceived* as "stupid," but it's really just a limitation of the data and the way I process information.
